lines.en: label yukidate1:
I tap on Yuki’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我点开手机里 Yuki 的名字，等她接。

lines.en: I haven’t really seen her at all since our last run-in at the bathhouse, and it definitely seemed like she had some things to...discuss with me.
lines.zh: 自从上次在澡堂碰面之后，我基本就没再见过她，而她当时看起来明显有些话要跟我……谈谈。

lines.en: Granted, it’s possible she just wants to drag me into an alley and beat me up.
lines.zh: 当然，也有可能她只是想把我拖进小巷揍一顿。

lines.en: And I’m pretty sure she could since she wears a leather jacket.
lines.zh: 而且我挺肯定她做得到，毕竟她穿着皮夹克。

lines.en: If you can’t tell, I may be slightly nervous given how horrible I am at dealing with Yumi’s temper...and this is the woman who started it all.
lines.zh: 如果你看不出来的话——我可能有点紧张，因为我实在太不擅长应付 Yumi 的脾气了……而这位，可是一切的始作俑者。

lines.en: : Yeah?
: Hey.
: Hey.
: Who’s this?
lines.zh: : 哪位？

lines.en: : It’s...your daughter’s teacher.
lines.zh: : 是……你女儿的老师。

lines.en: : Oooooh, shit. I was startin’ to think I’d never hear from you.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，操。我还以为再也等不到你消息了呢。

lines.en: : You hungry? Dinner offer’s still on the table.
lines.zh: : 饿了吗？请你吃饭的提议还有效。

lines.en: : Does accepting make this a date?
lines.zh: : 答应了的话，这算约会吗？

lines.en: : Pfft. Yeah, right.
lines.zh: : 噗。想得美。

lines.en: : I haven’t been on a date in ten fuckin’ years.
lines.zh: : 我他妈十年没约会过了。

lines.en: : Just think of it as payment for bothering the shit out of you for a little while.
lines.zh: : 就当是打扰你一阵子的报酬吧。

lines.en: : That sounds significantly less fun. But I’m in, I guess.
lines.zh: : 听起来就没那么有意思了。不过我去就是了。

lines.en: : Tojo Ramen?
lines.zh: : Tojo Ramen？

lines.en: : Yeah. Need a ride?
lines.zh: : 对。要我接你吗？

lines.en: : You drive?
lines.zh: : 你开车？

lines.en: : I’ve got a bike I could swing by on.
lines.zh: : 我有辆摩托，可以顺路载你。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Yeah, I’ll walk. I’m not a fan of motorcycles.
lines.zh: : 那个，我走路过去吧。我不太喜欢摩托车。

lines.en: : What?
: You fuckin’ scared or something?
lines.zh: : 你他妈是害怕还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Nope. Not scared at all.
lines.zh: : 不。一点都不怕。

lines.en: : See you soon, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 待会儿见，Yuki。

lines.en: : Uh-huh. Don't forget to tell your mom you’re going to be out late-
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。别忘了跟你妈说你要晚点回——

lines.en: I hang up the phone before Yuki begins to talk about how brave and manly I am, a thing she was definitely about to do.
lines.zh: 我在 Yuki 开始夸我有多勇敢多有男人味之前就挂了电话，而她绝对正打算说这个。

lines.en: scene black
I walk deeper into the winter winds, heading toward the old district with my hands buried inside of my pockets.
lines.zh: 我迎着冬日的风越走越深，双手埋在口袋里，朝老城区走去。

lines.en: It will be nice not having to pay tonight, sure.
lines.zh: 今晚不用掏钱当然不错。

lines.en: But I wonder how a conversation between Yuki and me could possibly go?
lines.zh: 但我好奇的是，我和 Yuki 之间的对话到底会怎么展开？

lines.en: scene yukifirstdate1
: Yo.
: Sure took your sweet ass time gettin’ here.
lines.zh: : 你可真他妈慢悠悠的。

lines.en: : The bike probably doesn’t sound so scary now, huh?
lines.zh: : 现在摩托车听着没那么可怕了吧？

lines.en: : Hello and welcome to Tojo Ramen. Is it your first time here?
lines.zh: : 您好，欢迎光临 Tojo Ramen。是第一次来吗？

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, I’m here all the time.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，我可是天天来的。

lines.en: : Fuck you.
lines.zh: : 去你的。

lines.en: Well that's one way to greet someone, I guess.
lines.zh: 好吧，这也算一种打招呼的方式。

lines.en: : So...you two are still {i}fucking{/i} each other, I see.
lines.zh: : 那么……你们俩还在互相{i}操{/i}对方呢，我看到了。

lines.en: : I am very glad that she cleared up that misunderstanding with you instead of me.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴她是跟你澄清了那个误会，而不是跟我。

lines.en: : Same.
lines.zh: : 我也是。

lines.en: : Weird experience, walkin’ in to get dinner and seeing the waitress and your daughter’s teacher talkin’ about boning.
lines.zh: : 挺怪的体验，进来吃个饭，就看见女服务员和你女儿的老师在讨论打炮的事。

lines.en: : What is “boning?” This is one more term I am not familiar with.
lines.zh: : 「打炮」是什么？这又是一个我不熟悉的词。

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 别管了，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : In fact, why don’t you stay out of this conversation entirely? I’m here to talk with Yuki.
lines.zh: : 其实，你为什么不干脆完全别插嘴？我是来跟 Yuki 说话的。

lines.en: : Ooooh, look at you sounding all serious.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，瞧你这副正经的样子。

lines.en: : Well, that’s why we’re meeting up, right?
lines.zh: : 不过我们本来就是为此才见面的，对吧？

lines.en: : Since you made it clear that it’s not a date, I mean.
lines.zh: : 毕竟你说清楚了这不是约会。

lines.en: scene yukifirstdate2
: Well, yeah. But that doesn’t mean we’ve gotta act like we're holdin’ a fuckin’ meeting or something.
lines.zh: : 话是没错。但那也不代表我们得搞得像在开什么操蛋的会议似的。

lines.en: : Just eat, drink, and talk.
lines.zh: : 就吃饭、喝酒、聊天。

lines.en: : Pretend we’re friends or something. I don’t give a shit.
lines.zh: : 假装我们是朋友什么的。我无所谓。

lines.en: : Long as neither one of us makes this weird, it’ll wind up being easy as hell.
lines.zh: : 只要我们俩都不把这事儿弄得很怪，最后就会轻松得要命。

lines.en: : What will wind up being easy, exactly?
lines.zh: : 到底是什么会变得轻松？

lines.en: scene yukifirstdate3
: Gettin’ a progress report on my daughter, numbnuts.
lines.zh: : 听听我女儿的进度报告啊，蠢货。

lines.en: : How’s she doing? Beat the shit out of anybody yet? Any teachers?
lines.zh: : 她怎么样了？揍过谁没有？老师呢？

lines.en: : Wait, wait. You’re probably scared of me because she fucked you up already, didn’t she?
lines.zh: : 等等，等等。你怕我，大概是因为她已经把你揍过了，对吧？

lines.en: : Uhh...no. That is not a thing that has happened.
lines.zh: : 呃……没有。这种事没有发生过。

lines.en: : Well if you’re not boning her and she ain’t doing shit to you, how come you two are hanging out together after[school]?
lines.zh: : 那既然你没和她上床，她也没对你怎么样，你们俩为什么 [school] 放学之后还总混在一起？

lines.en: : You know, I had a feeling Yumi would be the topic of conversation tonight, but I can’t say I was expecting the world’s most informal PTA meeting.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我早就猜到今晚的话题会是 Yumi，但我可没想到会是全世界最不正式的家长会。

lines.en: : Your daughter has a very unique attitude.
lines.zh: : 你女儿的态度非常独特。

lines.en: : I believe she would make an exceptional drill sergeant.
lines.zh: : 我认为她会成为一名出色的教官。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene yukifirstdate4
: Ah-
: Let me handle this, please.
lines.zh: : 这个让我来处理，拜托了。

lines.en: scene yukifirstdate5
: I just fuckin’ said that we don’t need to treat this like a meeting.
lines.zh: : 我他妈刚说过我们不用把它当会议来对待。

lines.en: : I really just want to know how she’s doing.
lines.zh: : 我真的只是想知道她过得怎么样。

lines.en: : And also whether or not we need to have a {i}talk{/i} about you getting closer to her than someone in your “position” probably should be.
lines.zh: : 另外也想知道，我们需不需要{i}谈谈{/i}你跟她走得比你这个「立场」的人该有的距离更近这件事。

lines.en: : You say that as if I’m not a model teacher.
lines.zh: : 你这话说的，好像我不是个模范教师似的。

lines.en: scene yukifirstdate6
: Well, if what Io tells me is true, you definitely aren’t.
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果 Io 告诉我的都是真的，那你肯定不是。

lines.en: I sit down at the table and realize that I’m already too deep into this topic to be able to order any food without killing the momentum.
lines.zh: 我在桌边坐下，意识到自己已经陷进这个话题太深，深到点餐都会打断气氛。

lines.en: I guess I’ll just have to go with the flow until Tsuneyo realizes that I am also a human being who needs to eat in order to stay alive.
lines.zh: 看来我只能顺着往下走，直到 Tsuneyo 意识到我也是个需要吃饭才能活着的人类。

lines.en: : Yumi is...definitely a student.
lines.zh: : Yumi 是……绝对是个学生。

lines.en: : Is that it? That’s all you’re gonna give me?
lines.zh: : 就这？你就打算告诉我这些？

lines.en: : Of course she’s a fucking student. What else?
lines.zh: : 她当然是个操蛋的学生。不然还能是什么？

lines.en: : Can I ask why you want to know all this?
lines.zh: : 我能问问你为什么想知道这些吗？

lines.en: : It just seems a little weird for you to start showing concern out of nowhere after all I’ve heard from her about you.
lines.zh: : 毕竟我从她那儿听到的关于你的那些事之后，你突然开始关心起来，感觉有点怪。

lines.en: scene yukifirstdate7
: And what did you hear from her?
lines.zh: : 那你从她那儿听到了什么？

lines.en: : That I’m a shit mother and a junkie and that I used to beat her or something?
lines.zh: : 说我是个烂母亲、瘾君子，还说我以前会打她之类的？

lines.en: : She definitely didn’t mention that last part.
lines.zh: : 最后那部分她倒确实没提过。

lines.en: : That’s not something you actually did, is it?
lines.zh: : 你应该没真的做过那种事吧？

lines.en: scene yukifirstdate8
: No! She’s my kid! I’d never fuckin’ do something like that!
lines.zh: : 没有！她是我的孩子！我他妈绝不会做那种事！

lines.en: : Can’t even tell you how many people I had to fuck up for just makin’ her cry.
lines.zh: : 光是把她弄哭的人，我都数不清揍了多少个。

lines.en: : It was like, a whole fuckin' thing back when I was still hangin’ around that place.
lines.zh: : 在我还混在那地方的时候，那可是件了不得的大事。

lines.en: : The second Yumi would start crying, everyone would book it because they were all afraid they’d have to answer to me.
lines.zh: : Yumi 一哭，所有人撒腿就跑，因为他们都怕要来跟我交代。

lines.en: : And the other stuff? The drugs and the...abandonment?
lines.zh: : 那别的呢？毒品，还有……遗弃？

lines.en: scene yukifirstdate9
: That...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: : Yeah. She wasn’t lyin’ about that.
lines.zh: : 嗯。这个她没撒谎。

lines.en: : Kind of surprised she didn’t start saying anything worse, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我有点意外，她居然没说得更难听。

lines.en: : Thought for sure she’d make me out to be fuckin’ Satan reincarnated by now.
lines.zh: : 我还以为到现在她早该把我描绘成撒旦转世了。

lines.en: : Well you’re certainly no angel.
lines.zh: : 你当然也算不上什么天使。

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. I’m a bad fucking parent. You think I don’t know that?
lines.zh: : 是是是。我是个操蛋的家长。你以为我不知道吗？

lines.en: : But that doesn’t mean I don’t want to know how she’s doing.
lines.zh: : 但那不代表我不想知道她过得怎么样。

lines.en: : Just to check in and shit.
lines.zh: : 就是问问情况什么的。

lines.en: : She’s around the same age I was when everything started fallin' apart, so it’s...nice seeing that she’s not completely fucked up yet.
lines.zh: : 她现在的年纪，差不多就是我一切开始崩塌时的年纪，所以……看到她还没彻底完蛋，挺好的。

lines.en: : What exactly happened to you when you were her age?
lines.zh: : 你像她这么大的时候，到底发生了什么？

lines.en: scene yukifirstdate10
: That’s a story for another time.
lines.zh: : 那是以后的故事。

lines.en: : You’ve been chill so far, so I wouldn't mind talkin' about it. Just not today.
lines.zh: : 你目前还算好相处，所以我不介意聊聊。只是今天不行。

lines.en: : All you {i}really{/i} need to know is that I ain’t doin’ that shit anymore.
lines.zh: : 你{i}真正{/i}需要知道的只有，我已经不干那档子事了。

lines.en: : Not like I expect it to change anything at this point, but yeah.
lines.zh: : 虽然我也不指望事到如今能改变什么，不过，是啊。

lines.en: : Either quit now or wind up in a fuckin' dumpster, you know?
lines.zh: : 要么现在戒，要么最后躺进操蛋的垃圾箱，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Not really. I can’t say this is an area I have much experience with.
lines.zh: : 不太懂。这领域我可没什么经验。

lines.en: : Oh, good. Thanks for reminding me that my life is shit and everyone else’s is so much better.
lines.zh: : 哦，好啊。谢谢你提醒我我的人生一团糟，而别人都好得多。

lines.en: scene yukifirstdate11
: Dude, it’s a joke.
lines.zh: : 老兄，这是玩笑。

lines.en: : Your delivery is somehow just as bad as Tsuneyo’s.
lines.zh: : 你讲笑话的方式简直跟 Tsuneyo 一样烂。

lines.en: scene yukifirstdate12
: It’s true. But I have only been associating with people for several months now.
lines.zh: : 这是事实。但我开始与人交往，也才几个月而已。

lines.en: : You have no excuse. Please stop trying to be funny.
lines.zh: : 你没有任何借口。请别再试图搞笑了。

lines.en: : Jesus Christ, sorry. Didn’t realize everyone here was so dead inside.
lines.zh: : 耶稣基督，抱歉。没发现这儿的人都死气沉沉到这个地步。

lines.en: scene yukifirstdate13
: So, you said before you were helping her find a job or some shit, right?
lines.zh: : 那么，你之前说在帮她找工作什么的，对吧？

lines.en: : How’s that going? Anyone bite yet?
lines.zh: : 进展如何？有人上钩了吗？

lines.en: : Not yet. But it’s not like she’s particularly...adept when it comes to job interviews.
lines.zh: : 还没有。不过她在面试这方面确实算不上……在行。

lines.en: : What’s that mean? She ain’t qualified or some shit?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？她不够资格还是怎么的？

lines.en: : More like she threatened to beat the shit out of customers who stole from the store during one of her last interviews.
lines.zh: : 不如说，她在上一次面试里威胁说要把从店里偷东西的顾客揍个半死。

lines.en: : And?
lines.zh: : 然后呢？

lines.en: : And that’s not a thing you can really say during a job interview.
lines.zh: : 然后这种话在面试里是真的不能说的。

lines.en: : Well, why the fuck not? Think showin’ that level of dedication would be a huge plus for managers and shit.
lines.zh: : 那他妈为什么不能？我觉得展现出这种程度的敬业精神，对店长什么的应该是巨大加分项。

lines.en: : I’d hire her.
lines.zh: : 我会雇她。

lines.en: Well, she is definitely Yumi’s mother, if not anything else.
lines.zh: 好吧，就算别的什么都不像，她绝对是 Yumi 的妈妈。

lines.en: : Let’s look at things this way...what was your first job?
lines.zh: : 我们换个角度看……你的第一份工作是什么？

lines.en: : Uhh...my parents owned a candy shop when I was little.
lines.zh: : 呃……我小时候家里开了家糖果店。

lines.en: : I kind of helped out there until I was a [teenager], I guess.
lines.zh: : 我大概就在那儿帮忙，一直帮到 [teenager] 时候吧。

lines.en: : I don’t think helping out parents really counts. What about the first job you had as a [teenager]?
lines.zh: : 帮父母的忙应该不算。你 [teenager] 时候的第一份工作呢？

lines.en: : Oh. None.
lines.zh: : 哦。没有。

lines.en: : None?
lines.zh: : 没有？

lines.en: : Nah.
: I was one of those “This town is boring. I’ve gotta get away.” kind of girls.
lines.zh: : 我是那种「这镇子太无聊了。我得离开。」的女孩。

lines.en: : So I left when I was in [high_school] and fell in with some gang.
lines.zh: : 所以我 [high_school] 的时候就走了，然后混进了某个帮派。

lines.en: : Just chilled with them for a few years until I met Yumi’s dad and then mooched off of him after that.
lines.zh: : 跟他们混了几年，直到遇上 Yumi 她爸，之后就靠他养着。

lines.en: : Fucking lowlife, by the way. She tell you about him, too?
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，那人是个操蛋的人渣。她也跟你说过他了？

lines.en: : Just that he’s in the yakuza.
lines.zh: : 只说了他在黑道。

lines.en: : She hasn’t mentioned that much about either one of you, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话，你们俩她都没提过太多。

lines.en: : The two of us aren’t exactly friends.
lines.zh: : 我们俩也算不上朋友。

lines.en: : Does she have {i}any{/i} friends? Can’t imagine it’s easy makin’ any given her upbringing.
lines.zh: : 那她{i}有{/i}朋友吗？以她的成长环境，我想交朋友不容易吧。

lines.en: : One.
lines.zh: : 一个。

lines.en: : Well, one and a half.
lines.zh: : 嗯，一个半。

lines.en: : How the fuck can you have half of a friend?
lines.zh: : 半个朋友是怎么个操蛋算法？

lines.en: : It’s her friend’s little sister. Yumi looks after her sometimes.
lines.zh: : 是她朋友的妹妹。Yumi 有时候会照顾她。

lines.en: scene yukifirstdate14
: {i}Yumi{/i} does?
lines.zh: : {i}Yumi{/i} 会？

lines.en: : Like, {i}my{/i} Yumi? Looking after a kid?
lines.zh: : 就是，{i}我家那个{/i} Yumi？照顾一个小孩？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: She’s surprisingly good at it, too.
lines.zh: : 而且她意外地很擅长。

lines.en: : Well isn’t that a fuckin’ steaming pile of irony.
lines.zh: : 这可真是一坨冒着热气的操蛋讽刺。

lines.en: : You gonna tell me she’s running a charity next, too?
lines.zh: : 你接下来该不会要告诉我她还在开慈善机构吧？

lines.en: : No. But she {i}does{/i} steal and resell old TV’s in order to feed herself.
lines.zh: : 没有。但她{i}确实{/i}会偷旧电视再转卖，好让自己有饭吃。

lines.en: scene yukifirstdate15
: There we go. There’s that good ole entrepreneurial spirit.
lines.zh: : 这就对了。这才像样的老派创业精神。

lines.en: : Must be takin’ after her grandpa.
lines.zh: : 肯定是随她外公。

lines.en: : Pretty soon, she’ll have her own fuckin’ candy store for some other little rebel to come steal from.
lines.zh: : 用不了多久，她就会有自己的操蛋糖果店，等着别的叛逆小鬼来偷。

lines.en: : The cycle fuckin’ continues.
lines.zh: : 循环他妈又转起来了。

lines.en: : This is a strange thing to seem proud about.
lines.zh: : 这看上去是件很奇怪的、值得骄傲的事。

lines.en: : Hey, she’s out there trying to build something for herself. ‘Course I’m gonna be proud.
lines.zh: : 嘿，她在外面打拼，想给自己挣出点什么。我当然会骄傲。

lines.en: : Think I’d have these bags under my eyes if I did the same thing at her age instead of just fallin’ in with some punks and livin' the easy way?
lines.zh: : 如果我在她这年纪也干同样的事，而不是跟着一帮小混混走那条轻松路，你觉得我现在还会有这黑眼圈吗？

lines.en: : That is a weirdly positive way to look at things, but I’m pretty sure I agree.
lines.zh: : 这是一种奇怪的积极看法，不过我大概是同意的。

lines.en: scene yukifirstdate16
: Shit, man. Her own business.
lines.zh: : 操，老兄。她自己的生意。

lines.en: : I...don’t know if I’d call it a {i}business{/i}-
lines.zh: : 我……不确定能不能管这叫{i}生意{/i}——

lines.en: Yuki remains silent for a few moments and I get caught up in watching the smoke trail off of her cigarette, only to be sucked up by the hoods of Tojo Ramen.
lines.zh: Yuki 沉默了片刻，而我看着她香烟上升起的烟雾出神，那烟被 Tojo Ramen 的抽油烟机一口吸走。

lines.en: She seems strangely content right now. More content than a normal woman would be after learning her child is a semi-professional shoplifter.
lines.zh: 她此刻看上去出奇地满足。比一个正常女人听说自己孩子是半职业扒手之后该有的满足要多得多。

lines.en: But hey, with so many horrible things on this planet, I guess it wouldn’t be right to look down on anyone for managing to siphon some joy out of something slightly {i}less{/i} horrible.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，这世上可怕的事已经够多了，所以我想，谁要是能从一件稍微{i}没那么{/i}可怕的事里榨出点快乐，我也不该看不起人家。

lines.en: I do wish that I didn’t feel compelled to ask things like this, though-
lines.zh: 只是我真希望自己别总是忍不住要问这种问题——

lines.en: : Do you want to see her again?
lines.zh: : 你想再见她吗？

lines.en: scene yukifirstdate17
: Huh?
: If she agreed to it, would you want to meet up with her?
lines.zh: : 如果她同意的话，你会想见她一面吗？

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure Yumi doesn’t know you’re sober.
lines.zh: : 我挺确定 Yumi 不知道你已经戒了。

lines.en: : Maybe it would change things if she figured out you were trying to be a better person?
lines.zh: : 如果她发现你在努力做个更好的人，也许事情会不一样？

lines.en: scene yukifirstdate18
: That’s not what this was about, man.
lines.zh: : 老兄，这可不是我找你的目的。

lines.en: : I wasn’t planning on getting to know you so I could find a way back into my daughter’s life or some shit.
lines.zh: : 我没打算先认识你，好借此找到回到我女儿生活里的路什么的。

lines.en: : I just wanted to check in on her.
lines.zh: : 我只是想问问她的情况。

lines.en: : Make sure she’s not still hangin’ out with all those yakuza punks and shit.
lines.zh: : 确认她没再跟那些黑道小混混混在一起。

lines.en: : You can’t just run out on your kid and then expect to walk back into the picture after gettin’ a little better.
lines.zh: : 你不能抛下自己的孩子，然后在稍微好一点之后就指望重新走进她的画面里。

lines.en: : That’ll fuck ‘em up even harder once things get bad again.
lines.zh: : 一旦情况再次变糟，那只会把她伤得更重。

lines.en: : Do you think there’s a chance things will get bad again?
lines.zh: : 你觉得情况有可能再次变糟吗？

lines.en: scene yukifirstdate19
: Heh.
: You don’t deal with people like me often, do you?
lines.zh: : 你不常跟我这种人打交道吧？

lines.en: : I can’t say I do, no.
lines.zh: : 确实不常，是的。

lines.en: : Rule #1 - Things can {i}always{/i} get bad again.
lines.zh: : 第一条规矩——事情{i}随时都{/i}可能再次变糟。

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter how fine I look now or how fine I look tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 不管我现在看起来多好，或者明天看起来多好。

lines.en: : The day after that, somethin’ could snap and I could wind up in a bag.
lines.zh: : 后天，某根弦就可能崩掉，我就装进袋子里了。

lines.en: : Goal is just makin’ it through each day so you can start fresh on the next one or whatever other “enlightened” shit they’re preaching in NA nowadays.
lines.zh: : 目标只是撑过每一天，好让你能在下一天重新开始，或者现在 NA 里布道的那些「开悟」的鬼话。

lines.en: : Just the way things work, unfortunately.
lines.zh: : 不幸的是，事情就是这么运作的。

lines.en: : And here I thought {i}I{/i} was the one who didn’t want to make an effort to change anything.
lines.zh: : 我还以为{i}我{/i}才是那个不想付出努力去改变什么的人呢。

lines.en: : Oh, shit...if only it were as easy as just “making an effort.”
lines.zh: : 哦，操……要是真像「付出努力」那么简单就好了。

lines.en: : Listen, man. You can say whatever the fuck you want. I’ve heard it all before.
lines.zh: : 听着，老兄。你想说什么都行。我全听过了。

lines.en: : But I’ll tell you the same thing I tell everybody else-
lines.zh: : 但我会告诉你我跟其他所有人说的同一句话——

lines.en: : It’s not that simple.
lines.zh: : 没那么简单。

lines.en: : I really wish it was.
lines.zh: : 我真希望它简单。

lines.en: : But it’s not.
lines.zh: : 但它不简单。

lines.en: scene yukifirstdate20
: I’d be happy to meet up with her if she wanted to.
lines.zh: : 如果她想的话，我很乐意见她。

lines.en: : But I’m not asking you to try and make shit like that happen when she has bigger fish to fry.
lines.zh: : 但我不是在要你为了这种事去折腾，她还有更要紧的事要忙。

lines.en: scene yukifirstdate21
: Did I hear fried fish?
lines.zh: : 我听到炸鱼了吗？

lines.en: : Are you ready to order?
lines.zh: : 您准备好点餐了吗？

lines.en: : Just...give me the same thing Yuki is having.
lines.zh: : 就……给我来一份和 Yuki 一样的。

lines.en: : There’s no fish in that at all. Are you sure this is what you want?
lines.zh: : 那里面一点鱼都没有。您确定要这个吗？

lines.en: : Give me literally anything, Tsuneyo. I’m starving.
lines.zh: : 随便什么都行，Tsuneyo。我快饿死了。

lines.en: : I understand.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : I will go get you one of everything.
lines.zh: : 我去给您每样都来一份。

lines.en: : That’s not-
lines.zh: : 那不是——

lines.en: scene yukifirstdate22
: And she’s gone.
lines.zh: : 而她已经走了。

lines.en: : You expect anything else? She’s a fuckin’ weird kid.
lines.zh: : 你还能指望别的吗？她就是个操蛋的怪小孩。

lines.en: : They all are. Everyone in my class.
lines.zh: : 她们都是。我班上的每一个人。

lines.en: : Sorry to put you on the spot, but...you really think Yumi would want to see me again now that I’m not all...fucked up?
lines.zh: : 抱歉把你逼到这份上，不过……你真觉得 Yumi 会想再见我吗？现在我不再那么……一团糟了。

lines.en: : I have no idea what Yumi wants literally ever. But I don’t think it would hurt to ask.
lines.zh: : 我从来就不知道 Yumi 想要什么，字面意义上的从来不知道。但我觉得问问也没什么损失。

lines.en: : Well...again, I’m not askin’ you to go out of your way for something like that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……再说一次，我不是要你为了这种事特意跑一趟。

lines.en: : I’m fine just hearing she’s doing okay.
lines.zh: : 光是听说她过得还行，我就满足了。

lines.en: : But...I ain’t gonna try and stop you.
lines.zh: : 不过……我也不会拦着你。

lines.en: : I know how fuckin’ hardheaded guys get when they think about doin’ something.
lines.zh: : 我知道男人一旦想做什么事，脑子能他妈有多轴。

lines.en: : And...yeah, I guess I {i}do{/i} kind of want to see that brat.
lines.zh: : 而且……是啊，我大概{i}确实{/i}有点想见那个小鬼。

lines.en: : Don’t say anything to Io about it, though. Girl’s weirdly attached to me for whatever reason.
lines.zh: : 不过别跟 Io 提这件事。那丫头不知为什么对我莫名地依恋。

lines.en: : Don’t want her to get jealous and wind up gettin’ the shit kicked out of her after starting something with Yumi.
lines.zh: : 我可不想她吃醋，然后跑去跟 Yumi 挑事，最后被人揍个半死。

lines.en: : I will...definitely not mention anything to Io.
lines.zh: : 我……绝对不会跟 Io 提半个字。

lines.en: : And I’ll think more about saying anything to Yumi, too.
lines.zh: : 跟 Yumi 说不说，我也会再想想。

lines.en: : It just feels strange meeting up with you to give you a progress report when A: I hate progress reports. And B: This is the first time we’ve ever really {i}talked{/i}.
lines.zh: : 只是感觉挺奇怪的——跟你见面是为了给你一份进度报告，而 A：我讨厌进度报告。B：这还是我们第一次真正{i}说话{/i}。

lines.en: scene yukifirstdate23
: Well, hey. You’ve got my number now, so you can call whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 嘿，那什么。你现在有我号码了，想打随时打。

lines.en: : Can’t guarantee you’ll like hangin’ out with me at all. But it’s kinda nice havin’ somebody to talk to in a place like this, you know?
lines.zh: : 不能保证你会喜欢跟我混在一起。不过在这种地方有个人能说说话，还挺不错的，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Also, the food’s fuckin’ great and Tsu-chan is hilarious.
lines.zh: : 还有，这儿的菜他妈好吃，Tsu-chan 也逗。

lines.en: : Ah-
A gasp rings out from the kitchen and the sound of a metal pan being dropped rings throughout the ramen shop.
lines.zh: 厨房里传来一声倒抽气，紧接着是金属锅掉在地上的声音，在整家拉面店里回荡。

lines.en: It’s hard to tell if this is the result of Tsuneyo’s name being said (Albeit in short form) or if she’s just shocked that someone has acknowledged her...rare form of comedy.
lines.zh: 很难说这是因为 Tsuneyo 的名字被提起（虽然是简称），还是因为她震惊于居然有人认可了她那种……罕见的喜剧形式。

lines.en: scene black
Tsuneyo reappears and serves me the same bowl of ramen that Yuki has.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 再次出现，给我端上和 Yuki 一样的那碗拉面。

lines.en: We eat our respective dinners and, just as she promised, Yuki winds up paying for me.
lines.zh: 我们各自吃着晚餐，而正如她承诺的，最后 Yuki 替我付了钱。

lines.en: I still have no idea how I should progress with the Yumi situation, but it’s good knowing that things aren’t even half as bad as I thought they were at first.
lines.zh: 我依然不知道该怎么推进 Yumi 这件事，但知道情况远没有我一开始想的那么糟，这就很好了。

lines.en: Or, who knows? Maybe they are?
lines.zh: 或者，谁知道呢？也许就是那么糟？

lines.en: I can’t imagine what it’s like being in either of their shoes.
lines.zh: 我无法想象站在她们任何一人的立场上是什么感觉。

lines.en: So all I can really do now is just pull on every lever and press every button I can find until something happens.
lines.zh: 所以我现在唯一能做的，就是拉下我能找到的每一根拉杆、按下每一个按钮，直到有什么事情发生。

lines.en: So basically, life.
lines.zh: 基本上，就是人生。

lines.en: Yuki offers to give me a ride home but, once again, I decline.
lines.zh: Yuki 提出要载我回家，但我又一次拒绝了。

lines.en: Not because I am afraid of motorcycles-
lines.zh: 不是因为我害怕摩托车——

lines.en: But because I am afraid of how much hope I may have given her for something that will likely never happen.
lines.zh: 而是因为我害怕自己给了她多少希望，去指望一件大概永远不会发生的事。

$ yukidate1 = True
{i}Yuki’s affection has increased to [yuki_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Yuki 的好感度提升到了 [yuki_love]!{/i}
